dialog.text: Ismark makes room beside the stove. "The mist lets people enter more readily than leave. Before my sister Ireena travels, we must know whether the church can keep its own doors shut. Speak to Donavich, and face what waits below."

options.name: I will investigate the church.
options.text: "The church stands apart from the houses. Return to Ireena afterward. The Roadwarden can help you practice, and this stove is yours whenever you need it."

options.name: Rest and recover for free.
options.text: A door is barred, a kettle warmed. Your strength returns. There is no charge.

dialog.text: "We still hear cries from the church," Ismark says. "Donavich needs an answer, and Ireena needs a safer road."

options.name: Rest and recover for free.
options.text: A door is barred, a kettle warmed. Your strength returns. There is no charge.

options.name: I will return to the church.

dialog.text: Ismark checks the shutters. "You have done what the church could not do alone. Speak to Ireena herself; the decision to travel belongs to her."

options.name: Rest and recover for free.
options.text: A door is barred, a kettle warmed. Your strength returns. There is no charge.

dialog.text: "Tser Pool lies beyond the Old Svalich Road," Ismark says. "Keep Ireena away from the pack, and listen to Eva when you reach camp."

dialog.text: The village lamps are still alight. Ismark listens to your account of the camp. "Then there is a little more distance between my sister and the count tonight."

dialog.text: Ireena has packed a small bag but keeps her hand on the door. "Speak to Ismark first. I will not ask a stranger to walk into this without knowing why."
"Donavich has enough grief without us leaving a danger at his door," Ireena says. "Settle what is happening in the church. Then we can talk about the road."
Ireena shoulders her bag. "I will go to Tser Pool, if you will help clear the road. I choose to leave this house. Can I count on you?"

options.name: I will escort you to Tser Pool.
options.text: "Then take the Old Svalich Road. I will keep close when the mist thickens. We must deal with the wolves before we can call this a safe crossing."

dialog.text: "The road first, then Tser Pool," Ireena says. "We travel together, but I cannot fight the pack for you. Rest here if you need to."
"The pack is scattered. Let us speak to Madam Eva at Tser Pool," Ireena says. "A safe fire is only a beginning."
Ireena has left for the western road and Vallaki. Her old room stands quiet; Ismark keeps a lamp burning for her.
Ireena has chosen sanctuary at Saint Andral's Church in Vallaki. Her old room remains quiet; Ismark keeps the lamp ready for a visit.
The Roadwarden clears a table. "Friendly practice? No entry fee, and a loss leaves you here. Your first victory earns two copies of one chosen spell. Later games are just practice."

BAROVIA
Ismark offers shelter and free recovery.
Ireena decides when to travel.
The Roadwarden offers optional friendly practice.
Investigate the Village Church, return to Ireena, clear the Old Svalich Road, then speak to Eva at Tser Pool.
Use the overworld exit to travel between locations. Open the journal to check your current task.
A pale young man recoils from the light. "Stay back. I can hear your heart." The cellar door will not hold against him forever.
Doru has fallen back against the cellar wall. His hunger has not left him. Donavich waits for your decision: bind his son securely, or end his suffering.

options.name: Restrain Doru.
options.text: You secure Doru below the church. Donavich agrees to keep watch and warn the village. His son is still a vampire spawn; restraint buys safety, not a cure.

options.name: Put Doru to rest.
options.text: You end the danger beneath the church. Donavich kneels beside his son. No one calls this a rescue, but the village will sleep behind fewer barricades.

dialog.text: Doru remains bound below the church. Donavich has taken the watch. The hunger is contained for now; it has not been cured.
The cellar is silent. Donavich has covered his son and closed the door.

defeatDialog.text: Doru can no longer press the attack. His father stands in the doorway. Decide whether to restrain him or put him to rest. If you leave now, speak to Doru again to finish this decision.

options.name: Restrain Doru.
options.text: You secure Doru below the church. Donavich agrees to keep watch and warn the village. His son is still a vampire spawn; restraint buys safety, not a cure.

options.name: Put Doru to rest.
options.text: You end the danger beneath the church. Donavich kneels beside his son. No one calls this a rescue, but the village will sleep behind fewer barricades.

dialog.text: Donavich keeps one hand on the cellar door. "My son returned changed. I cannot feed his hunger, and I cannot keep pretending the lock is enough. Subdue him before he hurts someone."
"You have stopped him for a moment," Donavich says. "Go to Doru. Choose restraint or death. I will not mistake either for a cure."
Donavich tests the bindings. "I will keep watch. The village must know what is here. Thank you for leaving me this duty, even if I cannot call it hope."
Donavich sets a candle by the closed cellar door. "There is nothing more to ask of him now. Tell Ismark the church is quiet."

The church register stops in the middle of a name. A newer note records Doru's return and the first broken lock. The handwriting grows smaller on each line. This is evidence of danger, not a recipe for reversing it.

options.name: Remember the warning.
options.text: You mark the entry in memory. The register cannot settle Doru's fate.

dialog.text: Shapes move between the trees. Without Ireena's agreement to travel, there is no reason to force this crossing. Return to the village and speak to her after resolving the church.
The pack fans across the track. Ireena draws back to the waystone. Break their line so you can reach Tser Pool together.
Only pawprints remain. The road to Tser Pool is open. Speak to Madam Eva there to finish this leg of the journey.
A weathered stone points toward Tser Pool. Someone has scratched a second message beneath the arrow: KEEP WALKING WHEN THE WOODS GO QUIET.

options.name: Remember the way.
options.text: You note the turn toward camp. A sign can show the route; it cannot clear the wolves.

dialog.text: A rider waits beyond the trees, too still to have arrived by accident. "You have begun to make choices in my valley," he says. "Do keep making them." He turns his horse before you can answer. This is no battlefield, and the count offers no duel.
Madam Eva holds a place beside the fire. "You have come ahead of the person you promised to protect. Go to Barovia. Let Ireena choose the journey, and make the old road safe for her."
"The road has teeth yet," Eva says. "A campfire is not proof that your crossing is safe. Face the pack on the Old Svalich Road, then return with Ireena."
Eva studies you and Ireena across the fire. "You have brought her this far. Before you rest, will you hear what the valley asks of those who would leave it?"

options.name: Hear Eva's warning and take the western road.
options.text: "Do not mistake distance for freedom. Vallaki has walls, but ask what those walls protect." Eva folds her hands. "Take Ireena along the western road. Seek shelter at Saint Andral's Church, and listen carefully when someone tells you all is well." No reading is dealt tonight. A new journal chapter begins.

options.name: I will return to hear it.

dialog.text: Eva turns a coal in the fire. "The western road leads to Vallaki. Clear its ambush, speak to the gatekeeper, then seek Father Lucian at Saint Andral's Church. A promise of safety deserves a question." Your journal now follows A Light in Vallaki.
The place by the fire is empty. Ireena is still in Barovia. Speak to Ismark, resolve the church, and ask her to travel.
Ireena watches the tree line. "We still owe the road an answer. Let us deal with the wolves before we settle here."
Ireena warms her hands. "You left Donavich a hard watch, but you did not leave him alone. Thank you for walking with me. Eva is waiting."
Ireena warms her hands. "Donavich will need people around him after what happened. I will remember that when we can return. Thank you for getting us here. Eva is waiting."
The fire marks the last place you rested with Ireena before the western road. In Vallaki she will meet you at Saint Andral's Church. Urwin offers recovery in the square.
The place by the campfire is quiet. Ireena has chosen sanctuary at Saint Andral's Church. The road back to Vallaki remains open.

WESTWARD ROAD
West Svalich Road leads to Vallaki. Hear Eva's warning before setting out with Ireena. In town, Urwin offers free recovery; Father Lucian tends Saint Andral's Church. Travel through the overworld exit. Your journal records each next step.
Hear Madam Eva's warning at Tser Pool after bringing Ireena safely along the old road.
The causeway narrows between black pools. A wolf pads into the road; others wait behind it. Ireena braces beside the marker. Break the ambush before approaching Vallaki together.
The causeway is quiet. Speak to the gatekeeper in Vallaki; the walls are visible through the trees.

VALLAKI
The western track ends at a walled town. Clear the ambush, then speak to the gatekeeper. A painted sun has been nailed over an older warning. Below it, someone has written: ASK WHO KEEPS THE NIGHT WATCH.

A raven balances on the marker. It looks from Ireena to the western walls, then gives a single impatient croak. The mist carries the distant sound of a bell. Nothing here requires a payment or a leap into the marsh.
Hear Madam Eva's warning at Tser Pool after bringing Ireena safely along the old road.
Clear the ambush on West Svalich Road before bringing Ireena into Vallaki.

The gatekeeper studies the mud on your boots. "Keep the road trouble outside. If you need a bed, ask Urwin by the square. If you need a sanctuary, ask Father Lucian. Those are different questions." Ireena steps through beside you.

options.text: The gate closes behind you. Find Father Lucian at Saint Andral's Church. Urwin offers free recovery in the town square.
options.name: Enter Vallaki with Ireena.

dialog.text: "The gate is open to you," the guard says. "Urwin by the square; Father Lucian at the church. And mind the notices. Someone is always checking whether you look cheerful enough."
Urwin keeps his voice below the clatter of dishes. "You can rest here without owing me coin. Ireena should speak for herself about the church. The notices promise happiness; we try to offer supper."

options.text: Urwin sets out bread and a clean cup. Your wounds are tended without a charge. Outside, the town bell insists everything is well.
options.name: Rest and recover for free.

options.text: Urwin points across the square. "Father Lucian tends Saint Andral's Church. The coffin shop belongs to Henrik. Talk before you start opening doors. If something drives you out, recover here and try again."
options.name: Ask about the town.

Clear the ambush on West Svalich Road before bringing Ireena into Vallaki.
Speak to the gatekeeper in Vallaki; then seek Father Lucian at Saint Andral's Church.

Ireena watches a guard straighten a festival notice. "I wanted walls. Now I want to know what happens inside them. Find Father Lucian at Saint Andral's Church. I will meet you there when we know whether its sanctuary is sound."
Ireena has chosen to stay at Saint Andral's Church. Urwin keeps a room ready if she needs the square's noise for company. Speak to her at the church to revisit the journey.

VALLAKI: ALL WILL BE WELL
Urwin offers free recovery by the square.
Saint Andral's Church stands beyond the houses.
Henrik keeps the Coffin Maker's Shop.

Father Lucian looks past you to Ireena. "I would offer sanctuary, but the bones beneath our altar are missing. Without them I will not call these doors safe. Will you help us recover them? Milivoj tends the churchyard; ask what he has seen."

options.text: Lucian opens the empty recess. "No one is beyond a question. Speak to Milivoj in the churchyard; then follow the trail, not the town's reassuring posters."
options.name: Investigate the missing bones.

dialog.text: Speak to Milivoj in Saint Andral's churchyard about the missing bones.
Confront Henrik at the Coffin Maker's Shop. Learn what he is hiding before opening the storeroom.
Defeat the Coffin Shop Spawn before approaching the reliquary in the workshop.
Collect the bones from the reliquary in the Coffin Maker's Shop. Victory alone did not recover them.
Defeat the Belfry Stalker at Saint Andral's Church before returning the bones.

The intruder is gone. Lucian receives the wrapped bones. "The altar can be made whole tonight. How shall we tell the people whose shelter was put at risk? Either way, the guilty must help put it right."

options.text: Lucian settles the bones beneath the altar. "Henrik and Milivoj will answer to the people they endangered, here, without a spectacle. I will keep watch with them." The church bell sounds once. Speak to Ireena about staying.
options.name: Restore the bones; account for this privately.

options.text: Lucian settles the bones beneath the altar, then opens the doors. "The sanctuary failed because people were frightened into silence. The town will hear how it happened, and who helped repair it." The warning names the deed without calling for a mob. Speak to Ireena about staying.
options.name: Restore the bones; warn the town openly.
Hold the bones while I consider.

dialog.text: Lucian lowers his voice. "The bones are in place. Henrik and Milivoj have work to do, and people to answer to; I will see that they do it. Their private accounting is not an excuse to forget. Ireena can choose sanctuary here."
Lucian leaves the doors unbarred. "The town has heard the truth. Some are angry, but no one is being handed to a mob. We will mend the locks in daylight. Ireena can choose sanctuary here."

Milivoj grips the spade until his knuckles pale. "Henrik paid me to take the bones. I told myself it was only old earth and old stories. My family needed food. I did not ask why a coffin maker wanted them." He points toward the workshop.

options.text: "The Coffin Maker's Shop," Milivoj says. "Tell him I have spoken. I will stay here and tell Father Lucian myself."
options.name: Follow the lead to Henrik.

dialog.text: Milivoj sets the spade aside. "Henrik has the answers. I will not hide in the graveyard while someone else carries this." The confession is already recorded; there is no fee for hearing it again.

Henrik stands between the workbench and the storeroom. "I bought the bones. I thought I could keep the bargain small. Then the crates arrived, and something inside them began to breathe." He backs away from the door. "The wrapped box is beyond them. I will not ask you to call me innocent."

options.text: Henrik points to the box at the far end of the workshop. "Past the spawn. Take the bones, and tell Lucian I will answer for the bargain." Face the Coffin Shop Spawn, then collect the reliquary yourself.

dialog.text: Henrik keeps his hands on the bench. "I have told you where the bones are. Past the spawn, in the wrapped box. I will be here when Father Lucian asks for me."
Henrik has put aside his unfinished orders. "Lucian has work for me. I am going to do it." The workshop has no new bargain to offer.
